name: PRVVSM01.jcl
description:
This JCL job sets up the VSAM file infrastructure for the Provider Master file system by creating a primary indexed cluster (KSDS) and an alternate index to support multiple access paths for provider data. The job first removes any existing version of the Provider Master KSDS, then defines a new indexed cluster with fixed-length 121-byte records keyed on a 10-byte primary key, and establishes an alternate index on a 9-byte key (starting at position 10) allowing non-unique key access, enabling lookups of provider records by an alternate identifier.Key Functionalities:
Deletes the existing Provider Master KSDS cluster (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS) if it exists, suppressing any error condition to allow the job to continue regardless of whether the file was present.
Creates a new Provider Master primary KSDS cluster with a 10-byte primary key starting at position 0, fixed-length records of 121 bytes, allocated at 10 primary and 5 secondary cylinders, with share options (2,3) to allow concurrent access.
Creates an Alternate Index (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.AIX) on the Provider Master KSDS using a 9-byte alternate key starting at position 10, configured as non-unique (multiple provider records can share the same alternate key), with variable record sizes between 30 and 60 bytes, allocated at 2 primary and 1 secondary cylinder.
Defines an Access Path (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.PATH) linked to the Alternate Index, enabling application programs to access Provider Master records through the alternate key without referencing the alternate index directly.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Provider Master File rebuild process has been initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system attempts to delete the existing Provider Master File cluster (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS) along with all its associated components, unconditionally overriding any file expiration or retention dates (PURGE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the Provider Master File exists, it is completely removed including all data, index, and alternate index components; AND if the Provider Master File does not exist and the deletion fails, the error status is forcibly reset to success (MAXCC = 0) so that the process continues; AND in both cases (file existed or did not exist), the process proceeds to the next step of creating a new Provider Master File structure without stopping

rules.Rule_Name: DEFKSDS - IDCAMS - Provider Master File Cleanup with Error Suppression
rules.Rule_Description: Before rebuilding the Provider Master File, any existing version must be completely removed. If the file does not exist, the resulting error must be suppressed so that the rebuild process can continue uninterrupted.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Provider Master File environment has been cleared — either by successful deletion of the prior file or by suppression of the not-found error
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system creates a new Provider Master File cluster named MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The file must be created as a key-sequenced (indexed) file where records are stored and retrieved by a unique key; AND each provider record must be exactly 121 characters in fixed length — no shorter and no longer; AND the primary key (Provider ID) must occupy the first 10 characters (positions 1 through 10) of each record and must be unique — no two provider records may share the same primary Provider ID; AND the file must be configured for shared access allowing multiple programs and systems to read and update provider records simultaneously in a controlled manner (SHAREOPTIONS 2 3); AND initial storage of 10 cylinders must be allocated with automatic expansion in increments of 5 cylinders whenever the file grows beyond current capacity; AND a separate data component (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.DATA) and a separate index component (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.INDEX) must be created as part of the file structure

rules.Rule_Name: DEFKSDS - IDCAMS - Primary Provider Master File Structure Definition
rules.Rule_Description: A new Provider Master File must be created with a precisely defined structure, including fixed record length, a unique primary key, shared access capability, and pre-allocated storage with automatic expansion.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The primary Provider Master File (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS) has been successfully created
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system creates an alternate index named MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.AIX on the Provider Master File
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The alternate index must be explicitly linked to the Provider Master File (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.KSDS) via the RELATE attribute; AND the secondary key must be 9 characters in length, located at positions 11 through 19 of each provider record (starting at offset position 10); AND the secondary key must be defined as NON-UNIQUE — meaning multiple provider records are permitted to share the same secondary key value (e.g., multiple individual providers belonging to the same provider group); AND alternate index records must be variable in length, with a minimum size of 30 characters and a maximum size of 60 characters to accommodate varying numbers of primary keys per secondary key value; AND initial storage of 2 cylinders must be allocated with automatic expansion in increments of 1 cylinder; AND a separate data component (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.AIX.DATA) and a separate index component (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.AIX.INDEX) must be created as part of the alternate index structure

rules.Rule_Name: DEFKSDS - IDCAMS - Provider Alternate Index Definition for Secondary Key Lookup
rules.Rule_Description: An alternate index must be created on the Provider Master File to allow provider records to be searched and retrieved using a secondary 9-character key. Multiple providers may share the same secondary key, supporting group-level lookups.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Provider Alternate Index (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.AIX) has been successfully created
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system creates an access path named MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.PATH pointing to the alternate index
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A named access path (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.PATH) must be established that routes all secondary key-based provider lookups through the alternate index (MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.AIX); AND downstream programs must be able to access provider records using the 9-character secondary key by opening MMPRV.PROVIDER.MASTER.PATH directly, without needing to reference the alternate index structure explicitly

rules.Rule_Name: DEFKSDS - IDCAMS - Provider Alternate Index Access Path Definition
rules.Rule_Description: A named access path must be created that routes secondary key-based provider lookups through the alternate index, providing downstream programs a standardized and simplified entry point for secondary key searches without requiring direct knowledge of the alternate index internals.
